rule: Phase 5 quality-engineering and payment-security units are pre-planned here. They are not implementation claims and must enter the canonical active plan before coding.

units.name: Research & Discovery Governance
units.summary: ResearchBrief, VOC, problem validation, competitor/standards evidence, baseline and CTQ system for substantial new work.
acceptance_criteria: Substantial new capabilities carry evidence-backed problem/VOC/baseline/CTQ decisions before solution implementation.

units.name: Quality Engineering Operating System
units.summary: Lifecycle quality dimensions, proportional gates, DMADV/DMAIC, FMEA, traceability and control-plan governance.
acceptance_criteria: New/redesigned units use proportional DMADV quality evidence; existing regressions use DMAIC/control evidence; high/critical units include FMEA where applicable.

units.name: Data Architecture & Governance
units.summary: Formal data flows, classification, ownership, lineage, derived-store semantics, retention/export/delete and AI/package exposure policy.
acceptance_criteria: Material data systems have traceable authoritative source, tenant/access scope, lineage, retention/deletion and derived-store/AI/package policies.

units.name: Reliability Engineering
units.summary: SLI/SLO/error-budget policy, timeout/retry/idempotency, graceful degradation, fault testing and incident/reconciliation controls.
acceptance_criteria: Critical recurring services have meaningful SLI/SLO/recovery/fault evidence and package/provider failures are isolated and reconcilable.

units.name: Product Outcome Intelligence
units.summary: Privacy-aware adoption/task-success/time-to-value/error/feedback outcome measurement tied back to ResearchBrief CTQs.
acceptance_criteria: Major capabilities can compare intended CTQs/outcomes with privacy-safe post-release evidence without turning analytics into an authoritative data source.

units.name: Delivery Excellence
units.summary: Engineering-flow and DORA-style metrics, CI/review/release controls, rework/rollback visibility and AI-development quality feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Delivery speed and stability are measured without individual-developer ranking/gaming and regressions drive DMAIC control actions.

units.name: Cost & Resource Efficiency
units.summary: Provider-neutral cost/resource attribution for requests, tenants, storage, bandwidth, DB, AI, media, search and external providers.
acceptance_criteria: Cost/resource regressions are attributable and budgetable without leaking tenant/provider-sensitive information.

units.name: Payment Data & Trust Boundary
units.summary: Critical payment-provider security profile, provider-hosted/tokenized default, raw account-data exclusion and activation/certification policy.
acceptance_criteria: Standard payment integrations cannot expose raw PAN/CVV to Nexora/generic package runtime and cannot activate without payment-specific security evidence.

units.name: Payment Secret Broker
units.summary: Tenant/provider-scoped opaque credential references, encryption, rotation/revocation, masked Admin policy and no AI/log export.
acceptance_criteria: Payment packages use scoped brokered credentials rather than generic secret/database/filesystem access.

units.name: Payment Webhook Gateway
units.summary: Provider signature/freshness verification, tenant binding, replay/deduplication, schema/state validation and reconciliation before Commerce mutation.
acceptance_criteria: Forged/replayed/duplicate/out-of-order/wrong-tenant webhook events cannot create unauthorized financial transitions.

units.name: Checkout Payment Surface Guard
units.summary: Payment-page script inventory/authorization/integrity/tamper controls, strict CSP, approved slots and session-replay/analytics exclusion.
acceptance_criteria: Arbitrary Theme/Extension/custom scripts cannot execute on protected payment-entry surfaces and unauthorized changes are detectable.

units.name: Payment Provider Security SDK
units.summary: Purpose-specific payment capabilities, provider manifest profile, amount/state/idempotency contracts, network broker and sandbox verification harness.
acceptance_criteria: A reference sandbox provider can authorize/capture/refund/reconcile safely through typed least-privilege contracts and cannot directly set Core financial truth.
